WITH color_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    p.product_color,
    COUNT(*) as color_count
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  JOIN Products p ON ili.product_id = p.product_id
  GROUP BY p.product_color
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(color_count) as avg_count,
    SUM(color_count) as total_sum
  FROM color_counts
),
with_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    cc.color_count,
    cc.color_count * 1.0 / s.total_sum as ratio,
    s.avg_count
  FROM color_counts cc
  CROSS JOIN stats s
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    color_count,
    ratio,
    avg_count
  FROM with_metrics
  WHERE color_count > avg_count
)
SELECT 
  AVG(color_count) as avg_count_result,
  AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio,
  AVG(color_count - avg_count) as avg_difference
FROM filtered
